stages.title: Your workshop app
stages.description: A local application shell with supplied hosting helpers ready for the next lesson.

stages.title: Your first coach in DevUI
stages.description: Your ChatClientAgent uses a Foundry model and answers in DevUI.

stages.title: Connect the chat UI
stages.description: The agent is exposed through AG-UI and the supplied chat becomes the home page.

stages.title: A coach with a tool
stages.description: A deterministic practice-guidance function that the agent can call.

stages.title: InterviewData MCP server
stages.description: The repository service and emulator run alongside the coach. A supplied probe lists the server's tools.

stages.title: Connect InterviewData MCP
stages.description: The coach discovers interview tools and can create and fetch a record on request.

stages.title: Save and retrieve interview records
stages.description: Add the session lifecycle prompt: fetch or create, preserve fields, append new transcript text, and complete the saved record.

stages.title: Read a resume
stages.description: MarkItDown can extract a document when the coach is asked to read its URL.

stages.title: Document-aware coaching
stages.description: The complete single agent, connected to both InterviewData and MarkItDown MCP servers.

stages.title: Your first handoff
stages.description: Triage and the receptionist share document intake in a runnable two-agent workflow.

stages.title: Behavioural and technical practice
stages.description: Four agents handle intake and both interview phases. The chat page displays the session ID. Summary generation comes next.

stages.title: Five collaborating specialists
stages.description: Expand the two-agent workflow into the reference application's full handoff graph and scoped tool sets.

stages.title: The finished application
stages.description: The same working application as the summary-agent checkpoint, used for debugging and the workshop summary.
